exploratory_minimum: Verify exact wavelength vector, band ordering, bad/dropped bands, and spectral axis for each cube before wavelength-aware plots.
Resolve array units, physical measurement meaning, calibration procedure, and dark/white reference association; otherwise report only stored-array units.
Validate a sample-level mapping of source ID, trial, plant, isolate/control, leaf/part, dates, and experimental conditions.
Keep all repeat observations grouped by plant and analyses source-separated.
defensible_evaluation_additions: Independent plants for each intended class, including healthy controls and pathogen/isolate groups.
Multiple prospectively defined severity/progression stages when evaluating progression or forecasting.
Sample-linked pathogen identity confirmation and severity or disease-state ground truth.

Plant-level identifiers, replicate/trial, inoculation and acquisition dates, cultivar, environmental/acquisition conditions, sensor settings, reference captures, and full wavelength/calibration provenance.
Consistent measurement units/calibration or a justified harmonization protocol.
Predefined plant-level train/validation/test split with all leaves, captures, parts, and pixels for a plant held in one partition.

Study-specific sample-size planning informed by expected between-plant variability, class balance, model complexity, target precision/effect, and evaluation design; no universal minimum count asserted.

conditions: Confirm wavelength vector, spectral axis, units, and calibration for wavelength-aware/physical interpretation.

reasons: Only three independent plants, all in one trial.
No per-cube diagnostic confirmation or severity target.
Unresolved wavelength, calibration, and measurement units.
No verified plant-level mapping or wavelength vector.
Four exact healthy duplicate array pairs among eight healthy files.
Pathogens, study protocols, sensor/radiometric properties, and label provenance differ.
No justified harmonization or cross-study experimental design is established.
Bacterial leaf spot remains distinct from fungal disease targets.
